annotations.text: LOGO CASING — The supplied vector is lowercase “biltflow”; the film sets BILTFLOW in caps. This design follows the vector. Confirm which is the actual brand wordmark.
WORDING — The locked script uses “AI-native” and “for construction”; Raj argued against both on the 26 Aug call. This design uses the script’s wording. Raj to confirm.
CORONATION — Named as a client in the reference pack, never confirmed on any recorded call. Slot designed, left empty.
$5B+ — The script’s figure. Raj said $4.5B and $9B on the call. Script wins; verify before launch.
PALETTE — Light ground is deliberate. Raj’s investor storyboard is dark with blue; every competitor is dark-navy or blue. Light reads as a drawing set, not another AI product. Overrule if he objects.
